item.title: Mobile-Friendly Site for Roofing Company
item.description:
250-750 USD | Website Design & Development for Aftermath Roof & Restoration — Kansas City, MO
Project Overview
I am looking for an affordable, reliable web designer/developer to build a professional, mobile-friendly website for Aftermath Roof & Restoration, a roofing and restoration company serving the Kansas City metropolitan area.
Our primary markets are residential homeowners and multifamily property owners and managers. The website needs to establish credibility, generate inspection requests and phone calls, and communicate the importance of addressing roof damage promptly before it leads to more expensive problems.
I want a professional website that looks established and trustworthy without spending a fortune. I also need to be able to manage and update the website myself after launch.
Website: AftermathRoof.com
Important: I already own the domain and currently pay a monthly hosting fee. I need the freelancer to build the website and install it on my existing hosting account and domain. I am not looking to purchase a new domain or move to a new hosting provider unless there is a compelling technical reason.
Website Goals
Make it easy for people searching Google for “AftermathRoof,” “Aftermath Roof,” “Aftermath Roof & Restoration,” and variations including “Kansas City” to find our website.
Generate leads through phone calls and inspection request forms.
Present separate service information for residential roofing and multifamily/commercial property roofing.
Allow me to upload project photos and descriptions as jobs are completed.
Include an FAQ section that I can add to and edit myself.
Create a sense of urgency around addressing roof damage without misleading or overly aggressive sales tactics.
Establish a strong foundation for future local SEO and online marketing.
Required Pages
Home: Strong headline, clear calls to action, service overview, and links to the two primary markets.
Residential Roofing: Roof inspections, repairs, replacements, hail and wind damage, and applicable insurance-claim assistance.
Multifamily & Commercial Property Roofing: Roofing services for apartment communities, multifamily property owners, property managers, and ownership groups.
Projects / Our Work: An easy-to-manage photo gallery with project descriptions and categories.
About Us: Company introduction, values, and commitment to communication and workmanship.
FAQ: An editable section where I can add, remove, and update questions and answers.
Contact / Request an Inspection: Click-to-call phone number, email, and a working contact form.
The navigation can be simplified if you have a better user-friendly approach.
Design Direction
The brand uses a bold black, red, and white color scheme. I have an existing logo concept that will be provided.
The desired look is modern, clean, strong, professional, and easy to navigate. It should appeal to homeowners while conveying the reliability and professionalism expected by multifamily property managers.
The homepage should communicate a message along the lines of:
“Roof Damage Doesn't Wait. Neither Should You.”
The site should emphasize prompt action, professional assessments, clear communication, and preventing minor roof problems from becoming larger issues.
A professionally customized template is perfectly acceptable if it helps keep costs down. I do not need an expensive, fully custom-coded website.
Required Functionality
Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Working contact and inspection request forms.
Clickable phone number on mobile devices.
Easy-to-use content management system.
Ability for me to upload, organize, and caption project photos.
Ability for me to edit FAQs and basic website content without technical assistance.
Basic security, spam protection, backups, and SSL/HTTPS compatibility.
Google Search Console setup or assistance connecting it.
XML sitemap and appropriate indexing configuration.
On-page SEO, including page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and internal links.
Basic local SEO setup, including appropriate structured data and service-area information.
Optimized images and good loading speed.
Google Analytics integration if available at a reasonable cost.
WordPress is preferred, but I am open to another platform if it offers comparable flexibility, easy self-management, and low ongoing costs.
Existing Domain & Hosting Requirements
I already own AftermathRoof.com and pay for hosting.
The project should include:
Building the website and installing it on my existing hosting account.
Checking whether my current hosting plan supports the proposed platform before work begins.
Configuring the website to run properly on my domain.
Testing all pages, forms, phone links, mobile layouts, and basic SEO settings before launch.
Keeping my existing domain registration and hosting arrangement in place wherever technically feasible.
Please do not include new domain registration or a new hosting subscription in your quote. If my current hosting plan is unsuitable, explain the specific issue and proposed alternatives before recommending any change.
Ownership & Ongoing Costs
I want to retain control of my domain, hosting account, website administrator account, website content, and any paid licenses associated with the project.
Please identify any additional recurring fees, paid plugins, themes, subscriptions, or maintenance costs before work begins.
I must be able to update the site and add projects without paying a developer each time. Please do not make the website dependent on your personal account or a proprietary system that prevents me from managing it independently.
Deliverables
Completed website with all agreed pages.
Installation and configuration on my existing domain and hosting.
Mobile and desktop testing.
Working contact forms and phone links.
Basic technical and on-page SEO configuration.
Project gallery and editable FAQ functionality.
Administrative access and appropriate ownership transfer.
Brief instructions or a screen-recorded tutorial showing me how to update photos, projects, FAQs, and basic page content.
A short post-launch period for fixing bugs related to the agreed project scope.
Budget & Proposal Requirements
I am looking for a good-value solution and want to keep the initial investment reasonable.
Please include the following in your proposal:
Fixed-price quote: What is your total price to complete the website, including installation on my existing hosting?
Platform recommendation: What platform would you use, and why is it a good fit for this project?
Relevant examples: Links to websites you have built for roofing, construction, home services, or other local businesses.
SEO scope: What exactly is included in your initial SEO setup, and what results can you realistically support?
Ongoing costs: Any additional costs for plugins, themes, licenses, maintenance, or services beyond the hosting I already pay for.
Timeline: How long will the project take from the start date to launch?
Existing hosting: Can you install and configure the website directly on my existing hosting account and domain?
Self-management: Will I be able to add projects, upload photos, edit FAQs, and update basic content without hiring a developer?
Support and revisions: How many design revisions are included, and what post-launch support do you provide?
I am not looking for an expensive custom application or an ongoing developer dependency. I want a professional website that generates leads, can grow with the business, and is straightforward for a nontechnical owner to manage.
Please provide a clear, itemized proposal and identify anything that is not included in your price.
Thank you. I look forward to reviewing your proposals.

item.title: Wix Redesign: Philosophy Journal
item.description:
250-750 CAD | # Wix Website Redesign & Refinement for a Student Philosophy Journal
**Project Description**
I'm the founder of **Aletheia**, a Canadian student-led philosophy journal dedicated to making philosophical writing, critical thinking, and intellectual discussion more accessible to middle and high school students.
I currently have an existing website built using **Wix**, and I'm looking for an experienced Wix designer/developer to significantly improve its appearance, structure, and overall user experience.
**This is primarily a redesign and refinement project, NOT a complete website development project from scratch.**
The current website already has a basic structure and several functional pages. However, its design is relatively simple, and I would like to transform it into a polished, professional digital journal that feels comparable to established academic and literary publications.
## What I'm Looking For
**1. Professional Visual Redesign** - Modern, elegant, and distinctive editorial aesthetic. - Refined typography, spacing, layouts, and colour palette. - A professional homepage with a strong visual identity. - Consistent design across all existing pages. - Responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
**2. Improvements to Existing Wix Pages** - Redesign and reorganize the homepage. - Improve the About, Submission, and Contact sections. - Develop a professional journal/publication section. - Improve navigation and the overall browsing experience. - Remove unnecessary elements and improve the site's consistency.
**3. Journal & Publication Features** - An organized section for publishing student philosophical essays. - The ability to categorize essays by topic, submission track, or issue. - Clean, readable article pages. - A straightforward essay submission form with file uploads. - An easy way for administrators to upload and publish new essays using Wix's existing tools.
**4. Wix-Specific Requirements** - Work directly within my existing Wix website. - Preserve useful existing content and functionality. - Use Wix's built-in features and CMS where practical. - Avoid unnecessary custom coding or expensive third-party integrations. - Ensure that I can independently manage and update the website after completion. - Provide a brief explanation of how to publish articles and manage submissions.
## Design Inspiration
One website I particularly like is:
https://logosjournal.org/
I'm interested in a similarly polished, publication-focused aesthetic, with strong typography, intuitive navigation, and an academic atmosphere.
However, **I do not want a direct copy**. Aletheia should have its own distinctive branding and visual identity.
## Budget & Expectations
Since the website already exists on Wix, I'm hoping to prioritize improving the design and existing functionality rather than paying for a completely new development project.
I can share access to the existing website and further design references after discussing the project.
**My priority is finding someone with excellent design judgment who can transform an existing basic Wix website into a distinctive, professional, and easy-to-maintain online philosophy journal.**

item.title: Link building specialist for the German market (2 websites, no spam links)
item.description:
30-250 EUR | I run two German websites and I need a link building specialist with real experience in the German market (google.de): 1. A German SEO content agency website (B2B services). 2. A German online shop for social media growth services (an e-commerce niche that is sensitive with platform rules). I will share the domains with shortlisted applicants.
The task: build a small number of high-quality, relevant backlinks to both sites over 3 months. Quality matters far more than quantity. I expect a few good links per month, not hundreds.
What counts as a good link: - Placed on a real website with real organic traffic and real editorial content, in a relevant topic (marketing, SEO, business, creator or streaming topics, depending on the site). - Preferably German-language sites. Relevant English sites are fine if they make sense for the topic. - Link inside the article text, with brand, URL or natural anchors. No exact-match keyword anchors. - Acquired by outreach, guest posts, expert quotes, digital PR or similar. Not from link networks.
What I will not accept: - No PBN links, no Web 2.0 links, no profile, forum or directory spam, no bulk backlink packages, no comment links and no other low-quality or worthless links. - No guaranteed rankings and no "100 backlinks" offers. - No automated or AI-spun content. Proposals offering any of the above will be rejected.
Reporting: for every link, I need the URL of the linking page, the anchor text, the website's organic traffic estimate (Ahrefs or Semrush screenshot) and how the link was obtained. Links I cannot verify will not be paid.
How to apply: please start your proposal with answers to these three questions. Proposals without them will be deleted unread, and copy-paste proposals will be ignored.
1. Name 1-2 German-language websites where you built links (the target URL, the linking sites, and what changed). 2. Which 3 types of sites would you approach for a German SEO agency website, and why? 3. What do you charge? Please tell me the price per link or per month, and what exactly is included.
To show that you have read this brief, include the word "GREENFOX" in the first line of your proposal. Proposals without this word will be rejected automatically.

item.title: AI Platform for Distressed Deals
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to invest in a custom AI-driven platform that takes a distressed real-estate lead from raw data all the way through a signed purchase agreement—always targeting properties in pre-foreclosure, tax delinquency, or other high-motivation situations so we can acquire them well below market value.
Core capabilities I need • Data ingestion and enrichment: pull fresh owner and property details from public records, mainstream real-estate databases, and any relevant third-party APIs. The system must de-duplicate records, flag high-priority leads, and keep the data refreshed automatically. • Predictive identification: use machine-learning models to score which owners are most likely to accept a discounted cash offer. Transparency on the factors driving each score is important so I can tweak my acquisition criteria. • Multi-channel outreach: once a lead is approved, the platform should launch pre-configured SMS, e-mail, ringless voicemail, and postcard campaigns, then track every touchpoint in one timeline. • Conversation automation: integrate a GPT-style conversational agent that can handle routine seller questions and book calls into my calendar while handing complex threads off to me or my acquisitions manager. • Negotiation & contract workflow: auto-populate offer numbers, generate state-specific purchase agreements, route them for e-signature, and store everything in a secure deal folder. • Deal pipeline dashboard: Kanban or similar view showing lead → offer → under contract → closed, with projected profit and time to close calculations. • Mobile first: a companion app for both iOS and Android so I can review comps, fire off messages, or sign docs on the go.
Acceptance criteria 1. End-to-end demo that starts with raw data import and finishes with a signed test contract. 2. Accuracy metrics for lead scoring and outreach delivery provided in a written report. 3. Source code, model notebooks, and setup scripts delivered in a private repository with clear README. 4. Deployment documents for both cloud hosting and App Store / Play Store submission.
If you have prior experience mingling AI, prop-tech data feeds, and transactional workflows, let’s talk about milestones and timelines—I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: WordPress Website Speed & Core Web Vitals Specialist Required
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Website: https://shorturl.at/TZAs6 Platform: WordPress, CarDealer Theme, WPBakery, Slider Revolution Hosting: Krystal, LiteSpeed Server
Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced WordPress performance specialist to investigate and improve our website's loading speed, particularly on mobile devices.
Google Search Console reports poor Core Web Vitals, which may be affecting our SEO performance and customer enquiries.
We have already carried out extensive testing and need someone who can identify and resolve the underlying problems rather than simply install optimisation plugins.
Main Issues
1. Slow Server Response
Homepage takes approximately 2 to 2.5 seconds to generate.
Other pages generate in around 0.8 to 1.4 seconds.
Database queries account for only around 0.35 seconds.
We need to identify which PHP functions or theme components are causing the delays.
2. Poor Mobile Performance
Google reports mobile LCP of 4.4 seconds from real visitor data.
Mobile Lighthouse tests have recorded LCP between 8 and 14 seconds.
Desktop performance is considerably better.
Google identifies render blocking resources and image loading priority issues.
3. Theme and Caching Conflicts
LiteSpeed Cache causes incorrect mobile menus, logo sizing and header backgrounds, so it is currently disabled.
Removing the unused Google Maps API breaks the CarDealer vehicle search price slider due to script dependencies.
Any optimisation must preserve the site's existing functionality.
Work Required
We need someone to:
Identify performance bottlenecks through proper PHP profiling.
Investigate slow homepage processing and server response times.
Resolve caching and theme compatibility issues.
Improve mobile Core Web Vitals and image loading.
Protect existing SEO, vehicle listings, search filters and enquiry forms.
Provide before and after performance measurements.
Important: Approval Before Changes
We require a clear, step by step outline of findings and proposed changes before any modifications are made.
Please explain what you recommend changing, why, the expected improvement and any potential risks.
No changes to the live website without prior approval. Approved changes should be tested on a staging site first, with backups and a rollback plan.
